name: Polynomial Minimum Formulation
description: Replaces the direct inequality constraint with an algebraic property of a quadratic function parameterized by the two satellite states. By requiring the parabola I(x) = (x - s_u)(x - s_v) to have its global minimum at x = 1.5, we mathematically force (s_u + s_v)/2 = 1.5, which simplifies to s_u + s_v = 3. Given s_i in {1, 2}, this strictly requires s_u != s_v. This forces the model to perform algebraic deduction before it can recognize the underlying 2-coloring structure, defeating models that rely on keyword-based pattern matching to trigger graph algorithms.
